title: Labubu Funk
blurb: Labubu funk — the beat that soundtracked the great Labubu takeover, when a fanged little plush monster became the most fought-over collectible on the planet. Queues, resales, celebrity sightings, and a genuinely unhinged fandom, all set to this. Play it in tribute to whatever you're currently overpaying for. The teeth are part of the appeal.
origin: The funk track attached to the viral Labubu collectible craze.
